subject: surgery
title: Tumour Staging, Sentinel Nodes and Sarcoma Principles

steps.tx: Describing cancer extent by tumour size, node spread and distant metastasis is **tumour staging**. The TNM system is used worldwide so teams communicate precisely. Stage determines treatment and prognosis more than any other factor. Clinical stage comes from examination and imaging, while pathological stage after resection can change treatment for about a third of patients.
steps.say: Tumour staging by the TNM system describes extent and determines treatment and prognosis.

steps.tx: The universal language combining those three elements is the **TNM system**. Numbers after each letter grade severity within the category. Grouping combinations gives stages one to four for most cancers. Tis means carcinoma in situ, T0 no primary found, and TX means the primary cannot be assessed.
steps.say: The TNM system grades tumour, nodes and metastasis to group cancers into stages one to four.

steps.tx: The first lymph node draining a tumour, whose biopsy predicts the rest, is the **sentinel lymph node**. If it is clear, wider node clearance and its morbidity are avoided. Blue dye and tracer locate it during surgery. A negative sentinel node carries a false negative rate under 10 percent in trained hands, which is the figure quoted to patients.
steps.say: The sentinel node predicts nodal spread, and a clear result avoids wider clearance morbidity.

steps.tx: Immediate microscopic examination of tissue during an operation is **frozen section**. It checks margins and diagnoses unexpected findings while the patient is asleep. Accuracy is good but slightly below permanent sections. Paraffin sections take days but show detail frozen sections miss, so a frozen result can change after final histology.
steps.say: Frozen section checks margins during surgery while the patient remains asleep.

steps.tx: Treatment given before the main operation to shrink a tumour is **neoadjuvant therapy**. It can make inoperable tumours resectable and tests tumour sensitivity. Response also predicts prognosis usefully. Shrinkage also lets some breast and rectal cancers keep the organ, and complete clinical response may allow watch and wait in rectal cancer.
steps.say: Neoadjuvant therapy shrinks tumours before surgery and can make inoperable disease resectable.

steps.tx: Treatment after complete tumour removal to kill microscopic residue is **adjuvant therapy**. It lowers recurrence when risk is significant. Decisions balance recurrence risk against treatment toxicity for each patient. Adjuvant treatment is offered when absolute benefit outweighs harm; a 5 percent survival gain matters at high baseline risk.
steps.say: Adjuvant therapy after complete removal kills microscopic residue and lowers recurrence risk.

steps.tx: Surgery aimed at relieving symptoms rather than curing is **palliative surgery**. Bypassing obstruction or controlling bleeding can transform quality of life. It is chosen when benefits clearly outweigh operative burden. A gastrojejunostomy for gastric outlet block in pancreatic cancer restores eating for the months that remain, which patients value highly.
steps.say: Palliative surgery relieves obstruction or bleeding to transform quality of life without curing.

steps.tx: Cancers of connective tissue like fat, muscle and fibrous tissue are **soft tissue sarcomas**. The commonest adult type is liposarcoma, while rhabdomyosarcoma predominates in children. Desmoid tumours grow locally without metastasising, and retroperitoneal sarcomas present late and large, all needing wide excision planning at specialist centres with attention to hereditary syndromes and screening of families.
steps.say: Soft tissue sarcomas include liposarcoma and rhabdomyosarcoma and need specialist wide excision planning.

steps.tx: Population testing to find cancer before symptoms is **cancer screening**. Programmes exist for breast, cervix, bowel and lung in defined groups. Screening only helps when treatment of early disease improves outcomes. Screening brings lead time and length bias, so mortality reduction in trials, not just earlier detection, proves a programme works.
steps.say: Cancer screening finds disease before symptoms in defined groups where early treatment helps.
